evidence.quote: So today I want to share my perspective on the appropriate regulatory environment for foreign banks operating in the United States, as well as some thoughts on specific elements of that regime.
I believe the regulation implementing the Volcker rule is an example of a complex regulation that is not working well.
We are committed to tailoring our regulatory and supervisory regimes to align with the risk posed by financial institutions to the U.S. financial system.
